input.body:
Dear Miles,

Thank you for your email about Flat 10, 180 Alder Lane, Cedarford, ZZ3 4ZZ (ref R/PM010-1).

Unfortunately we can't see a photo with your message, only your signature, so the attachment may not have come through. Please could you reply to this email with a clear photo of the solar panel meter showing the current reading?

We'll check for it and follow up with you on 24 January if we haven't received it.

Kind regards,
Northbridge Lettings

data.reasoning: This only shows a signature, no actual photo attached. The reasonable response is to let the tenant know the photo isn't visible and ask them to resend it before I can proceed.

result.summary: This is a routine admin task: every 3 months the tenant has to send a photo of the solar panel readings for the landlord. The tenant's latest email (17 Jan, event 012) only had their signature in it and no photo is visible. I emailed the tenant to say no photo came through and asked them to send it again. I put the ticket on hold for 7 days so it gets chased. No escalation or landlord approval is needed.

judgement.why_this_decision: The tenant agreed by phone on 13 Jan (event 008) to send the photo. The agency chased by email on 17 Jan (event 010). Three minutes later the tenant replied (event 012), but the reply only contains a signature and the ticket has no attachments. The photo most likely failed to attach. The tenant is the only person who can fix this, so the right step is to ask them to resend it and hold the ticket.

alternatives_considered.why_not: The tenant probably thinks the photo was sent. If we stay silent, the task would stall with nobody chasing it.
There is no conflict, safety issue or cost decision, and the tenant can sort this out. The classifier's 'review' flag is covered by a direct reply to the tenant.
This is a recurring admin task with no repair or contractor, so moving it through repair stages wouldn't make sense.
